# Dabba
> Preorder links for home bakers in Pakistan. One order link: menu with prices, daily limits, deposits, and WhatsApp updates.

Dabba helps home bakers take preorders online without juggling Instagram DMs. Bakers share one link in their bio — customers see the menu, pick an open date, pay an advance by bank, Raast, or wallet, and upload a screenshot. The baker gets an order list, a daily baking list, and one-tap WhatsApp messages. Built for Pakistan, with Rupee pricing and local payment methods.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://dabba.devs.surf/): Landing page explaining how Dabba works for home bakers — from "price?" to paid order without a single DM.
- [Sample Bakery](https://dabba.devs.surf/s/cocoa-crumb): Demo shop page showing a menu with prices, sizes, flavours, and date picker.
- [Custom Cake Request](https://dabba.devs.surf/s/cocoa-crumb/custom): Form for customers to request custom cakes with inspiration photos and a quote that expires.
- [Order Tracking](https://dabba.devs.surf/o/K7Q2M9): Customer-facing order status page showing progress, payment state, and WhatsApp contact.
- [Pricing](https://dabba.devs.surf/#pricing): Simple monthly plans — Starter free up to 20 orders/month, Baker Rs 1,499/month, Bakery Rs 3,499/month. No commission on sales.
- [Privacy](https://dabba.devs.surf/privacy): Plain-language privacy summary covering data collection, storage, and user choices.
- [Baker Sign In](https://dabba.devs.surf/login): Sign-in page for bakers to access their dashboard.
- [Baker Dashboard](https://dabba.devs.surf/app): Live order alerts, daily baking list, menu editor, recipe costing, and settings.

## Feature pages

- [Daily Slot Limit](https://dabba.devs.surf/features/daily-slot-limit): Set how many orders you can bake per day. Full days close themselves automatically.
- [Custom Cake Quote](https://dabba.devs.surf/features/custom-cake-quote): Quote custom cakes in one tap with prices that expire.
- [Advance Payment](https://dabba.devs.surf/features/advance-payment): Ask for 50% or full payment upfront. Customers pay by Raast, bank, Easypaisa or JazzCash.
- [WhatsApp Replies](https://dabba.devs.surf/features/whatsapp-replies): Ready-written WhatsApp messages for order confirmations, reminders, and thank you.
- [Baking List](https://dabba.devs.surf/features/baking-list): Know what to bake every morning with daily totals by size and flavour.
- [Recipe Costing](https://dabba.devs.surf/features/recipe-costing): Turn today's ingredient prices into cost and profit per item.

## Tool pages

- [Cake Pricing Calculator](https://dabba.devs.surf/tools/cake-pricing-calculator): Price your cakes for profit. Enter ingredient costs, packaging, delivery, and time to see cost, profit, and margin per item.
- [Recipe Costing Calculator](https://dabba.devs.surf/tools/recipe-costing-calculator): Calculate the cost of your recipes. See profit per item at today's ingredient prices.
